messages:
carlos: Quick postmortem follow-up: root cause looks like handshake timeouts + silent stream drops during GC spikes. I sketched concrete actions and owners below. Please confirm by EOD.

emily: thanks. can you paste the timeline and proposed owners?

carlos: timeline + owners:
- short term (48h): add noisy-but-P2 alert for >2 partials/route in 10m, and a synthetic reconnect smoke test (owner: emily)
- next sprint: server-side keepalive & adjustable request window (owner: samir)
- next 3 sprints: adaptive per-tenant stream limits + quota UI (owner: tara)

tara: I can take the quota UI and help with the adaptive limits design. rough ETA: design by end of sprint, prototype next sprint.

samir: Ill take the server-side keepalive and request window tuning. plan: add feature-flagged defaults, run bench matrix across seq lengths. 2 week RFC.

emily: ack for synthetic tests + alerts. I want the alert to include runbook link and severity hint (P2 while we tune).

carlos: acceptance criteria (what well call "done"):
- synthetic test demonstrates reconnects resume with correct seq and no duplicate tokens
- partial_response_rate < 0.5% under baseline load and <1.5% during 3x burst tests
- alerts reliably surface the pattern and PagerDuty suppressed while P2
- runbook has clear escalation path and checklist for rolling back new defaults

emily: small sample prometheus rules Ill submit:
```yaml
- alert: ChatPartialSpike
  expr: increase(chat_partial_responses_total[10m]) > 2\  # per_route
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Partial responses spike on {{ $labels.route }}"
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/chat-partials
```

deposit-bot: deploy-bot: New deployment queued for infra/keepalive-feature on staging. See CI #1287.

samir: note: we should guard keepalive so its not overly chatty for mobile clients. propose client hint header `X-Stream-Heartbeat: auto|low|off`.

tara: +1 for client hint. also planning SDK change to support resumable token cursor and idempotency token. will add migration notes.

oncall-bot: FYI: oncall rotation notified. If alerts are P2 please add silence window for the first 48h of tuning.

emily: Ill add the synthetic test to CI and a dashboard panel: partial_rate heatmap by route/model + heartbeat latency. linking PR once created.

carlos: filing epic now and linking cards: EPIC-7894. I added owners, acceptance criteria, and milestones.

samir: ack. Ill kick off the bench matrix and post results to this thread.

tara: ack. will start design doc and post prototype screenshots when available.

emily: one more ask: include a retention of stream logs for 72h for incidents so we can do token sequence correlation. I will file a log retention task.

carlos: added. thanks everyone. if anyone needs to hand off, ping here. :thumbsup:
